```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\JournalEntry;

Route::apiResources([
    'users' => User::class,
    'journal-entries' => JournalEntry::class,
]);
```

This code snippet defines the API routes for `User` and `JournalEntry` models using Laravel's built-in `apiResource()` function. The `apiResources()` function automatically generates all necessary routes, such as index, show, store, update, and destroy methods, as well as resourceful routes like `/users/{user}` and `/journal-entries/{journal-entry}`.
